name: Tab Manager
description: Manage tabs with search, filter chips, favorites, sorting, collapsible groups, view toggle, recently closed tabs with group restoration, keyboard navigation, pin/mute controls, duplicate detection, and age-based color coding. Created by Steve Souza using Claude Code (experimental). Repo: github.com/stevensouza/tab-manager-chrome-ext

toggle-recent-tab.description: Toggle between current and most recent tab

navigate-tab-back.description: Navigate to older tab (by last accessed)

navigate-tab-forward.description: Navigate to newer tab (by last accessed)

goto-slot-1.description: Go to Quick Pick slot 1 (reopens by URL if closed)

goto-slot-2.description: Go to Quick Pick slot 2 — assign a key at chrome://extensions/shortcuts

goto-slot-3.description: Go to Quick Pick slot 3 — assign a key at chrome://extensions/shortcuts

goto-slot-4.description: Go to Quick Pick slot 4 — assign a key at chrome://extensions/shortcuts

goto-slot-5.description: Go to Quick Pick slot 5 — assign a key at chrome://extensions/shortcuts
